SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 2891
28. 11. 31.

November 28 1.

Dear Madam,

I have to acknowledge receipt of
your undated letter and to state that diligent
inquiries made with a view to tracing John
O'Connor, to whom you refer, have had a negative
result.

Yours faithfully,

Assistant Commissioner (Special Branch).

Mrs. Mary E. Browne,
Ballysheen,
Killinick,
Wexford,
Irish Free State.

28. 11. 31.
November 28 3.

Dear Father McGoldrick,

I have had exhaustive inquiries made with a
view to tracing John O'Connor who was supposed to live
in Shanghai from 1909 to 1930, but can find no trace
of him. Examinations of the records available have
failed to reveal any information which would throw
light on the report that O'Connor was associated in
Shanghai in hotel business with one Condon or Gordon
or that any person named Condon, Gordon or O'Connor
had a license for a hotel in Shanghai at any time
between 1909 and 1930. Inquiries at the American and
British Consulates and Catholic Churches have also had
negative results.

Yours sincerely,

W. Father F. McGoldrick,
St. Gabriel's Mission,
776 Avenue Joffre.

31年11月28日
11月28日 3.

尊敬的麦戈德里克神父：

我已就查找据称于1909年至1930年间居住在上海的约翰·奥康纳一事进行了 exhaustive（详尽）调查，但未发现其任何踪迹。对现有记录的审查未能揭示任何信息，以证实有关奥康纳在上海与一名名为康登（Condon）或戈登（Gordon）的人合伙经营旅馆的报告，也未能显示在1909年至1930年间的任何时期，有名为康登、戈登或奥康纳的人持有上海旅馆的执照。向美国和英国领事馆以及天主教堂进行的查询也均无结果。

此致
敬礼

W. F. 麦戈德里克神父，
圣加俾额尔传教站，
霞飞路776号。

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2891.
ate 16. 11. 31
Date Nov 16th 1931）

Subject (in full) John O'Connor

Made by D.S.Moore Forwarded by （签名）

Regarding attached letter from St Columban's
Missions concerning the above named individual.All enquiries
made in an effort to establish his supposed residence in this
city between 1860 and 1870 have proved abortive.Likewise,
his supposed association with one Condon or Cordon in the
managership of an hotel in Shanghai during the same years
may possibly be correct,but existing records have failed to
reveal either of the two names as being those of persons
interested in such an enterprise during that period.

（签名）
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch

November 27th,1931

Further enquiries,on the lines suggested by
the Officer i/c Special Branch,have been conducted in an
effort to establish the truth or otherwise that John O'Connor
did at one time reside in Shanghai.These enquiries like these
made during the initial investigations,have proved fruitless.

（批：JBR.
27/11）

（签名）
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch

堂 眞 崇 海 上

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2891
Date 16 : 11 : 31

October 18th 1931

Dear Mr. Givens:

I have received a letter of enquiry from Mary H. Browne, Ballysheen, Killinick, Wexford, about an uncle of hers, John O'Connor. He is thought to have lived in Shanghai between the years 1860 and 1870, trading in contraband shipping between Japan and China.

He was also thought to have been in partnership in a Shanghai hotel with a man named Condon or Cordon. The hotel is still in operation, so the relatives think, but Condon is dead.

Probably he did not register himself with the authorities on account of his smuggling profession. He left China and died in 1913 in Nebraska, worth a good deal of money, together with a good deal of property in houses and lands. The lawyers have located his Nebraska connections, but want to find out something about his activities and connections in Shanghai before they release the money.

Do you think you could hand this enquiry to some bureau or other which might be interested in tracing him. Should there be any detective agency in Shanghai which would do the searching, you might let me know of it, and I will communicate with his relatives at home. They of course would have to guarantee any expenses in the subject, so that I would wish to notify them first.

Sincerely yours,
[Signature]

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2891
日期 31年11月16日

1931年10月18日

尊敬的吉文斯先生：

我收到玛丽·H·布朗的查询信，地址为韦克斯福德郡基利尼克巴利欣，内容是关于她的叔叔约翰·奥康纳。据信他在1860年至1870年间居住在上海，从事日本与中国之间的走私航运贸易。

据信他还与一名名为康登（Condon）或科登（Cordon）的人合伙经营上海的一家旅馆。亲属们认为该旅馆仍在营业，但康登已去世。

可能由于其走私职业，他并未向当局登记。他离开中国，于1913年在内布拉斯加州去世，留下了相当多的金钱，以及大量的房屋和土地财产。律师们已经找到了他在内布拉斯加州的关系人，但在发放这笔钱之前，希望了解一些他在上海的活动和关系情况。

您认为能否将此查询转交给某个可能感兴趣并有助于查找他的部门或其他机构。如果上海有任何侦探社愿意进行此项搜索，请您告知我，我将与其国内的亲属联系。当然，他们需要担保与此事相关的任何费用，因此我希望先通知他们。

此致
敬礼
[签名]
